content: अनुवृत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Assenting to, approval; तवानुवृत्तिं न च कर्तुमुत्सहे <ls>Ku. 5. 65</ls>. .²2 Obedience, conformity, following, continuance in (<ab>opp.</ab> व्यावृत्ति); taking up; continuity; ज्येष्ठानुवृत्तिजटिलम् <ls>R. 13. 78</ls> by following the example of; अनुवृत्त्या प्रमार्ष्टुमागतः <ls>Dk. 100</ls> service; <ab>cf.</ab> also वाचानुवृत्तिः खलु अतिथिसत्कारः <ls>Pratimā 5</ls>. ततान वह्निः पवनानुवृत्त्या <ls>Ki. 16. 52</ls> in consequence of. .²3 Acting according or suitably to, compliance, acquiescence; gratifying, pleasing; कान्ता˚चातुर्यमपि शिक्षितं वत्सेन <ls>U. 3</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 58</ls>; <ls>K. 265</ls>; <ls>M. 2. 9</ls>; राज्यं हि नाम राजधर्म˚ परस्य नृपतेर्महदप्रीतिस्थानम् <ls>Mu. 3</ls> who conforms to or is true to the duties of kings; (previous) compliant or obedient spirit, previous course of conduct; <ls>U. 7. 5</ls>. .²4 Remembrance आसेदुषां गोत्रभिदोऽनुवृत्त्या <ls>Ki. 18. 18</ls>. .²5 (<ab>Gram.</ab>) Being supplied or repeated in a following rule; continued influence of a preceding on a following rule. .²6 Imitating, resembling <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 Repetition; वर्णानामनुवृत्तिरनुप्रासः.
